name: Hayes With Deano, Vil
description: For techno purists, Gare Porto is the destination to experience a night of deep, Detroit, and dub techno in a converted railway tunnel.
longDescription:
Hayes With Deano, Vil is a nightlife event featuring three DJs known for their selections in techno subgenres. The lineup includes Hayes, Deano, and Vil, who will be performing at Gare Porto. The event focuses on delivering a night of electronic music, specifically deep, Detroit, and dub techno, to an audience interested in these styles.

Attendees can expect a focused club night within the unique setting of Gare Porto, a venue housed in a converted railway tunnel. The atmosphere is geared towards a dedicated electronic music audience, with the event commencing at 11:00 PM on June 19, 2026. The duration of the event is typical for a club night, extending into the early hours.

Tickets for the event are priced at €10. Gare Porto is located near the city center and can be reached via public transport. The venue is a short walk from the São Bento metro station.

O evento foca-se em proporcionar uma noite de música eletrónica, especificamente deep, Detroit e dub techno, a um público interessado nestes estilos.

Os participantes podem esperar uma noite de club focada no ambiente único do Gare Porto, um espaço situado num túnel ferroviário convertido. A atmosfera é direcionada para um público dedicado à música eletrónica, com o evento a começar às 23:00 de 19 de junho de 2026.
